children: Frequency Electronics reported record first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $23.5 million, up 70% year-over-year and 52% sequentially, driven by stronger orders and a larger addressable market. The company recorded operating income of $5.2 million and net income of $4.2 million, or $0.41 per diluted share, while funded backlog rose to a record $129 million. Management highlighted expanded gross margin (~46%), improved operating leverage and a strengthened balance sheet after a $73 million secondary offering.
Revenue: $23.5 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (up from $13.8 million year-over-year).
Gross profit: $10.75 million; gross margin approximately 46%.
Operating income: $5.2 million for the quarter.
Net income: $4.216 million, or $0.41 per diluted share (three months ended July 31, 2026).
Cash from operations: net cash provided by operating activities of approximately $3.0 million for the quarter; cash and cash equivalents of $61.407 million at July 31, 2026.
Funded backlog reached a record $129 million at July 31, 2026, up 82% year-over-year and 16% sequentially, supporting near- and medium-term revenue visibility.
Management reported accelerating demand across larger end-markets and continued strength in space and defense applications leveraging the company’s precision time and frequency technology.
Completed a secondary offering during the quarter that materially strengthened the balance sheet, adding approximately $73 million in cash (with ~$14 million received after quarter-end).
Company remains debt-free and emphasized cash-generative operations on an annual basis going forward, alongside investments in R&D to expand capabilities and markets.
Management reiterated confidence in achieving or exceeding prior long-term revenue goals (targeting $150 million+ annual revenue by fiscal 2029) based on current momentum and order book.
